drug_class: Vasopressin analog; selective V1 receptor agonist

avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma Huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive vasoconstriction and hypertensive effects; risk of severe hypertension, arrhythmias, and ischemic events
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to discontinue immediately

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice root (high doses)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid-like effects causing sodium retention and hypokalemia; synergistic with terlipressin vasoconstriction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; if unavoidable, monitor electrolytes and blood pressure closely

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (stimulating varieties)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic effects may potentiate vasoconstrictive and hypertensive effects of terlipressin
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor vital signs

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements/Allicin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet and vasodilatory effects may partially counteract terlipressin vasoconstriction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; assess bleeding risk if concurrent anticoagulants present

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (high doses)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet and vasodilatory properties; minimal clinical significance with terlipressin
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; counsel on concurrent anticoagulant/antiplatelet monitoring

avoid_foods.name: High sodium foods/salt
avoid_foods.mechanism: Terlipressin increases water reabsorption and may contribute to hyponatremia; excess sodium complicates fluid-electrolyte management in portal hypertension
avoid_foods.action: Recommend sodium restriction as clinically appropriate; monitor serum sodium and fluid status

caution_foods.name: Licorice-containing candies/foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Minimal amounts in foods unlikely to cause clinically significant interactions; risk increases with chronic consumption
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient on avoiding excessive licorice-containing foods and beverages

monitoring_notes: Terlipressin is minimally metabolized hepatically, reducing drug-drug interaction risk, but its potent vasoconstrictive effects necessitate monitoring for hypertension, hyponatremia, and peripheral/splanchnic ischemia. Vigilant assessment of supplements with sympathomimetic or vasoconstrictive properties and careful fluid/electrolyte management are essential.
